info.title: CostControlsCustomConnector
info.description: Microsoft Graph beta Copilot Cost Management: credit balances, policies, credit requests and usage reports. Delegated sign-in only. Beta APIs are not supported for production.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement.Read.All. One credit balance row per billing method; no OData query options. Purchased and remaining quantities can be absent for pay-as-you-go. See setup guide for runtime-role caveats.

200.description: Tenant credit balance snapshot.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Filter only status/displayName/createdDateTime with eq/ne and and/or; status requires a qualified microsoft.graph.spendingPolicyStatus literal. Order only displayName/createdDateTime. No expand, skip or search. Follow @odata.nextLink unchanged when present; this connector returns one page.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: eq/ne on status (qualified enum), displayName (string up to 64 characters), createdDateTime (whole-second offsetDateTime); combine with and/or only. No functions, null or property comparisons.

200.description: One page of polymorphic policies.

post.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All plus Billing Administrator or Global Administrator at runtime. A nonempty initial assignedGroups additionally requires CopilotCostManagement-Assignment.ReadWrite.All. Policy is created disabled; audience type is immutable. No If-Match on creation. Safest group sequence: omit audience, create disabled, then add group references with a fresh ETag.

ETag.description: Parent policy concurrency token, including weak prefix and quotes.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Read a fresh policy before each mutation. Relationships are not expandable. Preserve any ETag header exactly; see setup guide if Graph omits it.

200.description: Polymorphic policy; ETag is declared for concurrency, although the operation page's example omits it.

ETag.description: Current parent policy ETag, if returned.

patch.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Requires current parent If-Match. Only displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit and billingMethods are writable; status and audit fields are server managed. Audience type cannot change.

200.description: Updated policy.

delete.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Deletes the policy using its current parent ETag.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Assignment.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Selected-groups policies only. No OData query options. Returns group objects; use ListAssignedGroupReferences for reference URLs.

200.description: Assigned group objects.

get.description: Documented $ref variant of ListAssignedGroups. Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Assignment.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. No OData query options.

200.description: Group reference links.

post.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Assignment.ReadWrite.All. Supply a group @odata.id reference URL and the current parent policy ETag, not a group ETag.

delete.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Assignment.ReadWrite.All. Removes only the policy reference, not the directory group. Removing the last group fails with 409 lastAssignedGroup.

204.description: Group reference removed; no response body.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Supports select only. Each setting exposes the parent's ETag and status; settings have no independent ETag.

200.description: Service settings.

post.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Requires current parent If-Match. Adds a service category, not an individual agent. No DELETE exists; update state to disabled to exclude a service.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Returns parentEtag and parentStatus; use parentEtag, not a separate child token, for mutations.

200.description: Service setting.

patch.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Only state is writable. Disabled excludes the service but retains the entry; it does not delete it. Disabling the last enabled service can fail with 409 atLeastOneServiceRequired.

200.description: Updated service setting.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Notify-only alert configuration; recipients are managed separately.

200.description: Alert configuration.

patch.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Merge PATCH; omitted fields stay unchanged, explicit null is rejected, thresholds [] clears thresholds. Empty {} is valid on an existing configuration. Create disabled, add recipient references, then enable. Requires parent If-Match even on first write.

200.description: Created or updated alert configuration.

delete.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Turns alerting off without removing the separately managed recipient references. Requires parent If-Match.

204.description: Alert configuration deleted; no response body.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. No OData query options. Returns user objects; use ListRecipientReferences for reference URLs.

200.description: Recipient user objects.

get.description: Documented $ref variant of ListRecipients. Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. No OData query options.

200.description: User reference links.

post.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Supply a real tenant user's @odata.id reference URL. Addresses are resolved at notification time. Requires parent If-Match.

delete.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Policy.ReadWrite.All. Removes only the alert reference, not the user. Removing the last recipient while alerting is enabled fails with 400 alertRecipientsRequired. Requires parent If-Match.

204.description: Recipient reference removed; no response body.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All. Read a named user; the parent userBalances collection is not listable. Expand serviceBalances to inline balances. Inspect unevaluatedServices for partial results and selectionDataStatus for source freshness; all-service failure returns 503.

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: Only serviceBalances is documented for expansion. Nested options are not assumed.

200.description: User balance; may be partial or contain no service balances.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All. Case-sensitive serviceId eq/in and isConsumptionAllowed eq; combine with and only. Order only serviceId. No skip/search. Top is an upper bound, not a page-size guarantee. Follow @odata.nextLink unchanged when present; this connector returns one page.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: serviceId eq (either side) or in (property on left, literal string collection on right); isConsumptionAllowed eq (either side); and only. Repeated clauses intersect; contradictions return no rows. No ne, or, not, functions, ranges or null.

200.description: One page of service balance rows.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All. Gets one case-sensitive service category's credit balance and access diagnosis, not an individual agent's cost.

200.description: Service balance row.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-CreditReq.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Runtime role: Billing Administrator, Global Administrator, AI Administrator, Global Reader or AI Reader. Excludes audit-only requests from rows/count; newest first. Follow complete @odata.nextLink unchanged; this action returns one page. Credit requests are access signals, not credit amounts.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Upper bound, not a guaranteed page size.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: eq only on state and serviceId, case-insensitive, using unqualified string literals such as state eq 'pending'. At most one clause per property, combined with and. Qualified enum literals are rejected. No orderby, expand, skip, search or delta.

200.description: One page; each request includes its strong @odata.etag.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-CreditReq.Read.All or ReadWrite.All. Runtime role: Billing Administrator, Global Administrator, AI Administrator, Global Reader or AI Reader. Includes strong @odata.etag in the body and ETag header. Audit-only requests can be read by ID; missing/out-of-scope requests return 404 itemNotFound.

200.description: Credit request with its current strong concurrency token.

ETag.description: Quoted strong ETag, also returned as @odata.etag.

patch.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-CreditReq.ReadWrite.All. Runtime role: Global Administrator, Billing Administrator or AI Administrator. Only state is writable. Pending can become approved/rejected; same-state decisions are no-ops but still check the request's strong ETag. Approval does not assign credits by itself. Missing If-Match: 428; weak/wildcard/malformed: 400; stale: 412. Do not retry writes automatically.

204.description: Decision recorded, or same-state no-op; no response body.

ETag.description: Advanced strong ETag on a state change; unchanged for a same-state no-op.

post.summary: Record credit request decisions in bulk
post.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-CreditReq.ReadWrite.All. Runtime role: Global Administrator, Billing Administrator or AI Administrator. 1-100 unique request IDs; each supplies its own strong etag, not an If-Match header. Non-atomic: HTTP 200 can contain failures. After partial success, reread affected requests and explicitly review only remaining decisions; never replay the original batch automatically. Approval records a decision, not a credit allocation.

200.description: Ordered per-item results, including failures; inspect responses and failedCount.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All; no application permission. Processed billable consumption for exactly one completed UTC day, not an arbitrary range. Follow complete @odata.nextLink unchanged; this action returns one page, not a snapshot-consistent tenant total. No currency or per-agent attribution.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Only userId eq with a string literal. No other operators, skip or search; order only by consumedQuantity.

200.description: One page of processed daily user consumption.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All; no application permission. One completed UTC day. 404 usageDataUnavailable is not proof of zero usage or user existence; 503 sourceUnavailable is not zero.

200.description: Processed consumption for the named user and day.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All; no application permission. Processed billable consumption attributed to security-group members for exactly one completed UTC day. Not a group allocation, balance or chargeback. Follow complete @odata.nextLink unchanged; this action returns one page and paging is not snapshot-consistent.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Only groupId eq with a string literal. No other operators, skip or search; order only by consumedQuantity.

200.description: One page of processed daily group-attributed consumption.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All; no application permission. One completed UTC day. 404 usageDataUnavailable is not proof of zero usage or group existence; 503 sourceUnavailable is not zero.

200.description: Processed consumption attributed to the named group and day.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Reports.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All. The API also supports those application permissions, but this connector remains delegated. Exactly one completed UTC day. Follow complete @odata.nextLink unchanged; this action returns one page and paging is not snapshot-consistent. Service categories, not individual agents.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Only serviceId eq with a string literal. Use governed service-category identifiers, not catalog entry IDs. No other operators, skip or search.

200.description: One page of daily service consumption.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Reports.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All. The API also supports those application permissions, but this connector remains delegated. One completed UTC day. 404 usageDataUnavailable is not proof of zero usage; 503 sourceUnavailable is not zero.

200.description: Consumption for the named service and day.

get.summary: List monthly usage by funding class
get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-Reports.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All. The API also supports those application permissions, but this connector remains delegated. Requires a calendar month, not date ranges. Complete unpaged funding-class collection, including unbilled overage and non-billable consumption. No currency, invoices, prices or settlement amounts. Freshness is snapshot sync time, not evidence that the month closed.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: UTC calendar month, YYYY-MM. No oldest permitted month is enforced by validation; this is not a retention guarantee. Date ranges, filter, top, skip and search are rejected.

200.description: Unpaged consumption by funding class.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All; no application permission. Raw billable-flagged usage bounded to the processed watermark, not reprocessed daily rankings. Required UTC timestamp window: start before end, end not future, at most 24 hours, no crossing UTC month boundaries except an exclusive end at next month's midnight. Totals/session counts need not equal processed reports. Parent collection is not listable.

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: services, sessions, or services,sessions. Expanded sessions may include sessions@odata.nextLink; use ListUserUsageSessionDetails for direct session paging. No filter, orderby, top or count.

200.description: Raw user detail; 404 usageDataUnavailable is not zero or proof of user existence.

get.summary: List raw user usage by service
get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All; no application permission. Use the same required UTC timestamp window as parent detail: at most 24 hours, nonfuture end, no crossing a UTC month except an exclusive end at next month's midnight. Unpaged; independently rounded child rows need not sum to the parent. Service key is id, not serviceId.

200.description: Complete raw service breakdown for the user/window.

get.description: Delegated CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All or CopilotCostManagement.Read.All; no application permission. Same required UTC timestamp window as parent detail: at most 24 hours, nonfuture end, no crossing a UTC month except an exclusive end at next month's midnight. Follow complete @odata.nextLink unchanged; this action returns one page, not snapshot-consistent. Activity without session identifiers can be omitted; rows need not sum to the parent. No single-session GET.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Upper bound, not a guaranteed page size. Default 20, maximum 100; no undocumented lower bound is imposed. No filter, orderby, count or skip.

200.description: One page of raw session groupings.

ServiceId.name: serviceId
ServiceId.description: Case-sensitive service category, for example cowork or workIQ. Not an agent ID.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Fresh PARENT spending policy ETag, copied verbatim including W/ and quotes. Required for every existing-policy mutation and child/reference edit. Do not invent a token or use a wildcard.

Select.name: $select
Select.description: Comma-separated documented structural properties; omit for the default response.

Top.name: $top
Top.description: Upper bound on returned rows, not a guaranteed page size. No undocumented maximum or default is imposed.

CreditRequestId.name: id
CreditRequestId.description: Credit request identifier, not a policy identifier.

CreditRequestIfMatch.name: If-Match
CreditRequestIfMatch.description: Fresh credit request's quoted STRONG ETag from @odata.etag or ETag. Not a policy token. Weak W/ and wildcard tokens are rejected. Missing header returns 428; malformed returns 400; stale returns 412.

CreditRequestSelect.name: $select
CreditRequestSelect.description: Comma-separated allowlist: id,state,requestType,requestedBy,decisionBy,createdDateTime,lastModifiedDateTime,expirationDateTime,serviceId. Other structural properties return 400; @odata.etag is a response annotation.

StartDate.name: startDate
StartDate.description: Inclusive start of exactly one completed UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. No oldest date is enforced by validation; retention is not guaranteed.

EndDate.name: endDate
EndDate.description: Exclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD; must equal startDate plus one day, with UTC midnight not later than now. Current-day, future and multi-day ranges are rejected, not clamped.

DailyReportTop.name: $top
DailyReportTop.description: Upper bound 1-100, not a guaranteed page size. Invalid values are rejected, not capped.

ConsumptionOrderBy.name: $orderby
ConsumptionOrderBy.description: consumedQuantity only, optionally asc/desc; dimension-key ordering is unsupported. Ties are broken internally.

StartDateTime.name: startDateTime
StartDateTime.description: Inclusive UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, up to seven fractional digits. Must be earlier than endDateTime; window at most 24 hours and cannot cross a UTC month boundary.

EndDateTime.name: endDateTime
EndDateTime.description: Exclusive UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, up to seven fractional digits, not later than now. The end may equal midnight on the first day of the next month. Invalid windows are rejected, not clamped.

GraphError.description: Standard Graph OData failure. Inspect error.code and innerError.code. Common statuses: 400 invalidRequest/unsupportedQuery, 403 Authorization_RequestDenied, 404 usageDataUnavailable/itemNotFound (also out-of-scope resources), 409 conflict, 412 preconditionFailed, 428 preconditionRequired for credit decisions, 429 tooManyRequests, 503 sourceUnavailable/serviceNotAvailable. Do not interpret omitted/failed data as zero. Batch decisions can return per-item failures in HTTP 200.

Retry-After.description: Server retry guidance when returned, notably for throttling.

request-id.description: Graph diagnostic request ID, when returned.

Quantity.description: Swagger 2.0 flattened union. Limited requires numeric value (zero means no consumption); unlimited MUST omit value. Never infer unlimited from zero or missing balance data. Conditional rules are described, not expressible with oneOf in Swagger 2.0.

unit.description: copilotCredit; unknownFutureValue is the evolvable-enum sentinel.

value.description: Required only for limited quantities; MUST be omitted for unlimited. No undocumented numeric bounds are imposed.

displayName.description: 10-64 characters; letters, digits and spaces only.

billingMethods.description: Flags string: notSpecified (default), prepaidCredits, payAsYouGo, unknownFutureValue; combinations such as prepaidCredits,payAsYouGo are valid.

serviceSettings.description: Required initial settings; at least one service must remain enabled.

assignedGroups.description: Selected-groups policy only. Omit or [] for safe disabled creation; nonempty requires Assignment.ReadWrite.All. See guide: inline group serialization is underspecified; prefer AddAssignedGroup.

billingMethods.description: Flags string; supports combinations such as prepaidCredits,payAsYouGo.

@odata.etag.description: Optional OData annotation, if supplied; not a substitute for confirming the parent ETag.

status.description: Read-only lifecycle: enabled, disabled, provisioning, provisioningFailed, unknownFutureValue.

IdentitySet.description: Graph identitySet. Unavailable identity details can be null; other Graph identity members are retained.

DirectoryGroupInput.description: Directory group object for the optional inline audience. The operation page does not specify a required serialization; prefer the documented separate $ref action.

DirectoryGroup.description: Graph group; extra properties are retained.

DirectoryUser.description: Graph user; extra properties are retained.

serviceId.description: Service category such as cowork or workIQ. No exhaustive service catalog is documented.

state.description: enabled governs the service; disabled excludes it. unknownFutureValue is a sentinel, not a recommended write value.
Set disabled to exclude, not delete. unknownFutureValue is a sentinel.

parentEtag.description: Parent policy ETag for concurrency; read-only.

UpdateAlertSetting.description: Merge PATCH. All properties optional; explicit null is rejected. Recipients cannot be inline.

isEnabled.description: Enable only after linking at least one recipient.

thresholds.description: Omit to preserve; [] to clear. Null entries are invalid.

AlertThreshold.description: Flattened Swagger 2.0 union. Percentage: integer value 1-100, omit unit. Absolute: positive value and unit matching the policy limit. Conditional bounds and required/forbidden unit rules require caller/server validation.

unit.description: Required for absolute only; matches policy limit unit (currently copilotCredit). Omit for percentage.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: Source modification time, not request time.

usageAsOfDateTime.description: Omitted when no usage read was performed.

purchasedQuantity.description: Omitted when no purchased pool exists.

remainingQuantity.description: Service-calculated value, not purchased minus consumed; omitted without a finite pool.

reason.description: upstreamFailure, noApplicablePolicy, unknownFutureValue. Not a zero consumption row.

spendingPolicyId.description: Selected policy; always present for an evaluated balance row.

serviceBalances.description: Inline when expanded; can be empty for a user with no consumption.

serviceBalances@odata.nextLink.description: Nested continuation annotation, if supplied by Graph; preserve unchanged.

CreditRequest.description: Binary service-access request, not an amount. Approval records a decision but does not itself assign credits. Read enums/service IDs are open for future values. Users create requests outside Graph; no create/delete API. Expiration is service-managed: 90 days after creation or a state-changing decision.

@odata.etag.description: Quoted strong request ETag, returned in the body as well as the header. Preserve quotes; not a weak policy ETag.

state.description: pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, unknownFutureValue. cancelled is historical; only a same-state no-op can target it.

serviceId.description: Open lowerCamelCase service-category identifier, for example cowork or workIQ. Not a fixed service catalog or agent ID.

CreditRequestDecisionIdentity.description: Only the user facet is populated. Null until a decision is recorded.

state.description: Use approved/rejected for a pending request. A recognized current state, including pending/cancelled, can be sent only as a same-state no-op with a valid ETag; other transitions are rejected.

requests.description: Unique requestId values required; uniqueness is by ID, not whole object. Empty/over-100/duplicate-ID/malformed payloads, including explicit null state, fail the whole action before processing.

requestId.description: Credit request identifier. Each ID must be unique within the batch.

state.description: Use approved/rejected for pending requests; recognized same-state no-ops still require a fresh ETag.

etag.description: Current quoted strong request ETag, not a weak or wildcard token. Missing/malformed/stale tokens produce a per-item preconditionFailed result.

failedCount.description: Count of all results other than succeeded; HTTP 200 does not mean every item succeeded.

responses.description: Results in input order; not atomic. Reread/review unresolved decisions before resubmitting.

requestId.description: Target ID; an omitted input ID is represented by the all-zero GUID.

status.description: succeeded, notFound, preconditionFailed, invalidStateTransition, failed, unknownFutureValue. Unknown statuses are not success.

etag.description: Updated strong token, present only for succeeded items.

UserUsageRecord.description: Processed billable consumption for one completed UTC day, distinct from raw user detail. No daily freshness field is documented.

unit.description: copilotCredit; preserve unknown future units rather than convert to currency.

sessionCount.description: Distinct non-null billable session identifiers subject to source filters/processing watermarks; need not equal raw detail sessionCount.

GroupUsageRecord.description: Processed billable consumption attributed to members of a security group. Not a balance, allocation, cost-center hierarchy or chargeback position.

sessionCount.description: Distinct non-null billable sessions attributed to the group, subject to source filters/processing watermarks.

ServiceUsageRecord.description: Tenant-wide processed consumption for a governed service category and one completed UTC day. No sessionCount or separate id is documented.

serviceId.description: Governed service category, not catalog entry or agent ID.

UsageDataStatus.description: Null when raw source has no as-of timestamp; not the request time, an error, a completeness guarantee or evidence of month closure.

latestSourceDateTime.description: Snapshot sync time for funding reports; source enqueue watermark for raw detail. Later reads can include more rows or a later watermark.

FundingUsageRecord.description: Consumption attributed to a funding class for a calendar month, not rated currency amounts.

fundingClass.description: prepaid, payAsYouGo, overage, nonBillable, unknownFutureValue. overage is unbilled consumption, not an invoiced excess charge. Distinct from billing-method enums.

UserUsageDetail.description: One user's raw billable-flagged usage in the requested timestamp window, bounded to the processed watermark. Distinct from processed daily rankings.

sessionCount.description: Billable-flagged activity sessions contributing to quantity; excludes non-billable activity and need not equal daily report counts.

services.description: Complete unpaged breakdown when expanded; independently rounded child rows need not sum to parent.

sessions.description: Expanded session rows can be paged and need not sum to parent.

sessions@odata.nextLink.description: Nested session continuation URL; preserve unchanged.

id.description: Governed service-category key, named id here rather than serviceId.

consumedQuantity.description: Independently rounded raw billable-flagged usage; child quantities need not sum to parent.

UserUsageSessionDetail.description: Native-source session grouping. Activity without session identifiers can be omitted. Not an agent record; no single-session GET.

id.description: Opaque row ID scoped to user/detail window; stable for repeated identical requests, not a global persistent session ID.

sourceSessionId.description: Native source identifier preserved verbatim, including null; distinct from id.

consumedQuantity.description: Raw billable-flagged session quantity; rows need not sum to parent.

GraphInnerError.description: Additional and nested OData error details are retained without recursive schema references.
